lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did he say why he wanted you to do that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: No. (shakes head "no")

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Which knife did you use?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: The same one he stabbed her with.

lines.speaker: FASASBENDER
lines.text: And how many times did he stab her again?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Once.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Are you sure about that? (Brendan nods "yes")

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So Steve stabs her first and then you cut her neck? (Brendan nods "yes") What else happens to her in her head?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: It's extremely, extremely important you tell us this, for us to believe you.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Come on Brendan, what else?
(pause)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: We know, we just need you to tell us.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That's all I can remember.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: All right, I'm just gonna come out and ask you. Who shot her in the head?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He did.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Then why didn't you tell us that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz I couldn't think of it.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Now you remember it? (Brendan nods "yes") Tell us about that then.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he shot her with his .22.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You were there though?
